logline: A measurement fixture, not a film: three lines, two languages, one pass of the TTS engine.
note: Used by .github/workflows/voice.yml to measure real-time factor and file size per engine. Never rendered.

shots.narration: Every second he saved, cost him one of his own.
The rain did not stop for three days, and neither did he.
هنوزم وقتی ناراحتی، به جای حرف زدن به خیابون نگاه می‌کنی؟
